card: Adds explicit timeouts to HTTPConnection calls in several functional tests and requires timing arguments to wait_until to be keyword-only. Without connection timeouts, tests can hang indefinitely on broken or unresponsive systems rather than failing promptly with a clear error. This is a small test-reliability fix that prevents stalled CI and local test runner jobs.
evidence: PR description: "Without a timeout, the test can hang forever on broken systems. This is fine, but it would be nice if the test instead failed with a nicer error message, indicating the timeout."
problem: Functional tests using raw HTTPConnection instances lack explicit timeouts, allowing test runs to hang indefinitely on stalled or broken connections instead of failing cleanly with a timeout message.

risk.why: A mistake in timeout handling would only cause functional test failures or premature test timeouts.

summary: Passes an explicit timeout to HTTPConnection instances across functional tests and marks timing arguments in wait_until methods as keyword-only. This prevents tests from hanging indefinitely when HTTP endpoints become unresponsive, triggering a clearer timeout failure instead.
